snippet.title: Abyss Vaulter: LDJAM 57 (Full Playthrough.)
snippet.description:
My entry, Abyss Vaulter for LDJam 57. The theme was depth and I decided instead of going into the depths, like try and escape that theme.

Play over on itch: https://sinclairstrange.itch.io/abyss-vaulter

This video was taken before I fixed a silly bug where double damage actually was getting multiplied by 50. :3
(Sorry for the crappy framerate in some places, OBS really hates me sometimes.)
